message_ref.description: Provider-issued evidence for the sent message; pass to edit_message / delete_message / reaction operations.

thread.description: Echoes the input thread when the send posted into a thread/topic container, so a silent drop is checkable. Absent when no thread was supplied or the adapter could not honor it.

reply_to.description: Echoes the input reply_to when the send quoted a specific message, so a silent drop is checkable. Absent when no reply_to was supplied or the adapter could not honor it.
